findings.detail: Stale base: the branch's merge-base (15ed0da) predates the ShortLink OG feature that now exists on main, so `git diff main` shows og_image/og_title, ensureShortLinkOgColumns, shortlinkOg.test.ts and ogShare.ts being deleted. Verified these are NOT branch changes — diffing merge-base..HEAD for those paths is empty and the branch's two commits touch only the 11 publish-status files. Merging without rebasing would silently revert the OG feature.
findings.fix: Rebase the branch onto current main before merging so the diff reflects only the publish-status changes and the ShortLink OG feature is preserved.

summary: The product publish/unpublish feature is correct and complete: runtime status column (no migrate, default 'published', wired into boot), new products default to draft, server-authoritative 422 publish guard, public catalog filters to published only, catalog-leak test green (3/3) and unedited with status kept out of PUBLIC_PRODUCT_SELECT, and the admin can see/flip status via GET /api/admin/products and the row button. No unrelated POS/SEO/marketing/OG code is changed by the branch itself; the only note is a stale-base artifact that should be resolved by rebasing before merge.
